documents.text: Don't Drink the Water (1969 film) Don't Drink the Water is a 1969 American comedy film starring Jackie Gleason and Estelle Parsons. It is directed by Woody Allen and based upon a 1966 play "Don't Drink the Water" by Woody Allen. The supporting cast includes Ted Bessell and Joan Delaney. In 1994, Allen remade the story as the television film "Don't Drink the Water", with himself as Walter Hollander. Walter Hollander, a caterer, is on vacation with his wife Marion and daughter Susan. source_segments.text: Don't Drink the Water (1969 film) Don't Drink the Water is a 1969 American comedy film starring Jackie Gleason and Estelle Parsons.
It is directed by Woody Allen and based upon a 1966 play "Don't Drink the Water" by Woody Allen.
The supporting cast includes Ted Bessell and Joan Delaney.
In 1994, Allen remade the story as the television film "Don't Drink the Water", with himself as Walter Hollander.
Walter Hollander, a caterer, is on vacation with his wife Marion and daughter Susan.
While flying to Athens, their plane is hijacked to Vulgaria, behind the Iron Curtain.
